requirements.requirement_text: Provider admission SHALL be coordinated across Worker instances using durable Cloudflare Durable Objects, not process-local memory. For OpenRouter free models, the limiter SHALL be keyed by a one-way hash of the provider account identity returned by `GET /api/v1/key`, so adding another key for the same account cannot multiply its allowance. It SHALL pace requests at no more than the documented 20 starts/minute and read the live daily limit and remaining quota (free accounts may have 50/day; eligible credited accounts may have 1,000/day). Cache the quota briefly, account for this system's starts since the snapshot, enforce global/per-user concurrency, honor `Retry-After` on definite 429 rejection, and fail closed when provider limits cannot be read. Provider credentials SHALL be transient to the rate-control lookup and SHALL NOT be stored in Durable Object state, Queue messages, logs or receipts. Durable Queue consumers SHALL use automatic concurrency scaling (no fixed maximum); the provider-account Durable Object SHALL keep outbound requests within the upstream account limit. Auto/model selection SHALL exclude provider models that are no longer present or that are no longer free; a stale catalog entry SHALL not cause an unbounded or paid fallback. A request whose provider outcome is ambiguous (including a lost response, 408, or 5xx after dispatch) SHALL NOT automatically call the provider again; an expired lease with an unfinished provider attempt SHALL settle as `provider_outcome_unknown`.

requirements.requirement_text: - New Chat billing SHALL use the existing canonical `users.credits` balance and `credit_transactions` ledger, with **USD 1 = 10,000 credits**, without importing or invoking the legacy billing module/component. The bounded reservation, actual-cost settlement, refund and reconciliation logic SHALL be a small modular Core implementation and SHALL be callable only for the claimed, fenced `worker_jobs` Chat job. A request with insufficient credits SHALL not reach the provider.

requirements.requirement_text: - Every provider request SHALL pass through `worker_jobs` + outbox + Cloudflare Queue. The consumer SHALL reserve credits before dispatch, request provider usage, settle from the provider-reported USD cost when valid (otherwise use verified token counts and the pinned shared price), round fractional credits up, and return unused reservation atomically with the result. A definitive upstream rejection may release the hold; timeout, 408, 425, 5xx, missing billable usage, or any ambiguous result SHALL not trigger a second provider request and SHALL keep its reservation visible for reconciliation.
